variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are declared in a VAR block, specifying name and type.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Strongly typed. Supports basic types, enumerations, subranges, records, and pointers.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Standard arithmetic, relational, and logical operators. Assignment is ':='.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: IF statements end with an explicit END.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: FOR loops specify start, limit, and optional step (BY). Must be closed with END.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Standard WHILE loop ending with END.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are procedures that declare a return type. The name must be repeated at the END.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays specify index range and element type.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Dictionaries/maps are implemented manually using arrays, trees, or linked lists.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
(* Modula-2 lacks built-in exceptions. *)
(* Often relies on returning status codes or global flags. *)
error_handling.notes: Standard Modula-2 does not have exception handling, though some dialects added it later.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Modula-2 provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Modula-2 supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Modula-2 provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Modula-2 converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Modula-2 represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Modula-2 formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Modula-2 branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Modula-2 defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Modula-2 iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Modula-2 organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Modula-2 stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Modula-2 groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Modula-2 tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Modula-2 organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
